brief.zh: 已知「下雨 → 地湿」「地湿 → 路滑」「下雨」，证出「路滑」。
brief.en: Given “it rains → the ground is wet”, “the ground is wet → the road is slippery” and “it rains”, prove “the road is slippery”.

hint.zh: 第一块套用给出「地湿」，它能接进第二块套用。
hint.en: The first Apply gives “the ground is wet”, which can go into a second Apply.

t.zh: 地基的第一块元件是套用：一个输入口接一句「如果…，那么…」，另一个接它的前一半，输出它的后一半。一句「如果…那么…」就像一台机器，套用就是把前一半喂给它。
t.en: The foundation’s first part is Apply: one input takes an “if …, then …”, the other its “if” part, and out comes its “then” part. An “if … then …” is like a machine, and Apply feeds it its “if” part.

t.zh: 「如果…，那么…」写成 →：「下雨 → 地湿」就是「如果下雨，那么地湿」。
t.en: “If …, then …” is written →: “it rains → the ground is wet” is “if it rains, then the ground is wet”.

after.zh: 套用只认形状，不管讲的是什么。推出来的「地湿」又当了下一步的输入。
after.en: Apply looks only at shape, never at what it is about. The “the ground is wet” it proved became the next step’s input.
